title: Airbus A400M Atlas
notice: The procedures are the sim's own checklists for the A400M (its language file): the item names and clues, and the names of the switch positions from the aircraft's tooltips. The language file does not keep the order of the items: the order here follows the clues (APU START 3 s after APU MASTER, engines one at a time, masters to RUN once all four run) and is ours. The ticks read the aircraft's own L: variables, the ones its panel states contain (batteries, APU, ADIRS, fuel pumps, signs, lights, ground spoilers, flaps, engines available), and the cockpit events of the engine masters and the start selector. Nothing was run on the aircraft yet: no control is marked verified, and a tick that never comes may mean the variable is not what it looks like.
sources: Official2024/Steam/microsoft-aircraft-a400m/minimal.fsarchive, en-us.locpak: A400.CHECKLISTS.* (the sim's checklists for the A400M) and A400M.TOOLTIPS.* (unencrypted archive)
Official2024/Steam/microsoft-aircraft-a400m/data/panelstates/*.ini: the aircraft's L: variables in cold and dark, on GPU, APU running and ready for takeoff

steps.text: FMS: set the departure and arrival airports, the route, the SID and the STAR.
steps.source: A400M language file (microsoft-aircraft-a400m, minimal.fsarchive, en-us.locpak): A400.CHECKLISTS.FMS_PROCEDURE.FMS1
steps.why: The sim's clue: "Set city pair in fms and select route along with sid and star".

steps.text: FMS: fill in every amber box (the EFB's fuel and payload page has the numbers).
steps.source: A400M language file (microsoft-aircraft-a400m, minimal.fsarchive, en-us.locpak): A400.CHECKLISTS.FMS_PROCEDURE.FMS2
steps.why: The sim's clue: "Fill in information with amber boxes. you can get this information from the efb on the fuel and payload section".

steps.text: FMS: pick the takeoff flaps, press the performance computation button and confirm: the V speeds are inserted.
steps.source: A400M language file (microsoft-aircraft-a400m, minimal.fsarchive, en-us.locpak): A400.CHECKLISTS.FMS_PROCEDURE.FMS3
steps.why: The sim's clue: "Select flaps for takeoff using the drop-down. press to perf computation button and confirm the data. this will insert your v speeds automatically".

steps.why: The sim's clue: "The frequency is set by pressing the button above or below the frequency and then typing in the frequency using the number pad. press the button next to it, this will toggle it from stby to active".

steps.text: Set the transponder code (the button under M1 on the radio panel, then the keypad).

steps.why: The sim's clue: "The transponder code is set bottom right of the radio unit pressing the button under the m1 and typing the code using the number pad".

steps.text: Set the EFIS mode on each side.
